title: Modeling Joint Tail Risk and Dependence for Cryptocurrencies via a Copula-Based Semiparametric Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.28524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study proposes a Bayesian copula-based bivariate semiparametric framework for jointly forecasting Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES) while modeling cross-asset tail dependence. The marginal dynamics are specified using four ES-CAViaR-type models, including extensions incorporating Rogers-Satchell and Garman-Klass volatility measures. To construct the copula inputs, we use the empirical ranks of standardized residuals, which depend on the marginal parameters, thereby linking marginal tail dynamics and dependence modeling without requiring fully specified marginal distributions. Clayton and BB1 copulas are considered, and adaptive Markov chain Monte Carlo methods are used for estimation and joint tail-risk forecasting. A simulation study under a DCC-GARCH-$t$ data-generating process evaluates the finite-sample forecasting performance of the proposed framework. translated_title: 基于Copula的半参数框架对加密货币联合尾部风险与依赖性建模
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种基于Copula的贝叶斯二元半参数框架，用于联合预测风险价值和预期损失，同时对跨资产尾部依赖性进行建模。边际动态采用四种ES-CAViaR类型模型进行设定，其中包括融合Rogers-Satchell和Garman-Klass波动率度量的扩展模型。为构建Copula输入，我们使用标准化残差的经验秩，这些秩依赖于边际参数，从而在无需完全指定边际分布的情况下，将边际尾部动态与依赖性建模联系起来。研究考虑了Clayton和BB1 Copula，并采用自适应马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法进行估计和联合尾部风险预测。通过在DCC-GARCH-t数据生成过程下的模拟研究，评估了所提框架的有限样本预测性能。利用比特币和以太坊的数据，我们评估了一步向前预测……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Copula的贝叶斯二元半参数框架，通过ES-CAViaR边际模型与标准化残差经验秩相结合，在无需完全指定边际分布的情况下，联合预测加密货币的VaR与ES并同时刻画跨资产尾部依赖性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian copula-based bivariate semiparametric framework that jointly forecasts VaR and ES while capturing cross-asset tail dependence for cryptocurrencies, linking ES-CAViaR marginal dynamics to dependence modeling via empirical ranks of standardized residuals without requiring fully specified marginal distributions.
